MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

description: Request payload for the `capacity.settings.update` command: the Project's caps, replaced wholesale. An omitted cap field clears that cap, so the global default stands on the dimension again.

max_active_lanes.description: The Project's maximum active Lane count; omitted imposes none.

max_active_per_harness.description: The Project's harness ceiling; omitted imposes none.

max_active_per_model.description: The Project's model family ceiling; omitted imposes none.

max_active_per_usage_pool.description: The Project's usage pool ceiling; omitted imposes none.

project_id.description: The Project whose caps are being replaced.

title: CapacitySettingsUpdateRequest
